action.name: Nothing: the push is the workflow's work

description: culture-rules#124: every 15 minutes, runs repodocs-sync on spark, which pushes each top-level repo's specs, plans, deliveries, designs and .devague files under ~/git to culture-library (a working draft reaches the library within one cycle, 15 minutes plus the run). The concurrency key keeps one run at a time: a slot that fires while a run is going waits for it. Ships disabled: enable it after the library side is deployed and the grant LIBRARY_REPODOCS_PUSH_API_KEY is stored (docs/operations/repodocs.md). A missed slot is not caught up; the next one covers it.
name: Push repo documents to the library every 15 minutes
